name: sharepoint-knowledge-workbench
description: Independently-installable domain plugins for the SharePoint Knowledge Workbench: source-document-extraction, document-structure-analysis, structured-content-assembly, and structured-content-rendering convert a source .docx manual into validated, structured, published content (Markdown and SharePoint ASPX); sharepoint-content-publication and sharepoint-agents-and-skills handle tenant publication and agent/native-skill lifecycle; workbench-setup provides foundational connection/config/workflow setup for the whole workbench.

plugins.name: sharepoint-discovery
plugins.description: Read-only analysis of exported classic SharePoint inventories: per-page migration complexity scoring and functional grouping of web-part code. All classification rules and behavioural knowledge are caller-supplied.
